sampling.method: explicit diff scope and caller context; not a whole-repository audit
sampling.regions: all modified regions in four files; selected surrounding call sites
sampling.source_files_count_command: git ls-files source extensions, excluding .repos, .worktrees, dependencies, builds and audits

hot_paths.trigger: open member body or safe fallback

attackers: a sender supplying ambiguous separators or HTML-like content
a local user pasting an envelope-looking text
threat_model.surface: presentation parser and Markdown render; no new endpoint, provider dispatch, authorization or database operation
threat_model.origin_warning: Presentation never proves a sender identity or message origin

slos.note: No service SLO inferred from this UI-only scope

warnings: Modified regions and caller context only; not all lines of the monorepo or the four large files
No CVE scan, provider call, production restart or storage migration
No instrumented coverage, mutation testing or Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals measurement
Cumulative lint warnings pre-exist the diff according to the principal's baseline comparison
Initial freeze was lifted for confirmed boundary and long-header copy defects; final audit uses the corrected freeze
